item.title: Claude Code in the Terminal: The Deep-Dive
item.description: Most teams use Claude Code like a smart autocomplete. The teams getting real leverage treat it as an engineering platform — with CLAUDE.md, permissions, hooks, sub-agents, skills, and CI/CD integration designed in from the start.
